resolution.title: tests/bgp: Add mgmtd set-src regression coverage
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

Adds regression coverage for the mgmtd FRR replay gap that previously dropped the default-route `set src` entry when configs grew large.

The new file `tests/bgp/test_frr_set_src_mgmtd.py` verifies that both kernel default routes and FRR route-maps continue pointing to Loopback0 after a standard mgmtd reload and after a reload preceded by injecting 512 static routes via `sonic-cfggen`. Both tests run on T0/T1 hardware and are gated on `frr_mgmt_framework_config`.

Fix #21342
Fix https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/24694

Testing regression for https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/21931
Original issue https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/issues/18541 is fixed in upstream by https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/pull/18601

### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Testbed and Framework(new/improvement)
- [x] New Test case
    - [ ] Skipped for non-supported platforms
- [ ] Test case improvement

### Back port request
- [ ] 202205
- [ ] 202305
- [ ] 202311
- [ ] 202405
- [ ] 202411
- [ ] 202505

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Prevent regressions where mgmtd’s FRR replay loses the default-route source IP (Loopback0), especially when replaying long configs.

#### How did you do it?
- Added helpers to read Loopback0 per ASIC and validate both kernel and FRR state.
- Implemented two mgmtd tests: one plain reload, one reload after injecting 512 static routes (with checkpoint/rollback cleanup).
- Required `frr_mgmt_framework_config` so the tests only run where mgmtd is enabled.

#### How did you verify/test it?
- `python3 -m compileall tests/bgp/test_frr_set_src_mgmtd.py`
- `pytest tests/bgp/test_frr_set_src_mgmtd.py -k mgmtd_preserves_default_route_set_src_with_large_config`

#### Any platform specific information?
Runs on hardware T0/T1 (skipped elsewhere); no platform-specific logic.

#### Supported testbed topology if it's a new test case?
`t0`, `t1`

### Documentation

I don't think updating documentation is necessary for this one? Please correct me if I'm wrong.
